laws.rule: In the town of Mali Lošinj, the communal order decision bans gathering or lingering on public spaces in front of shops and cafés to drink alcoholic or soft drinks. Public events and cafés with an approved terrace are exempt. The decision names no fine for an individual for this rule.
laws.heading: Grad Mali Lošinj, Odluka o komunalnom redu (1 August 2019), article 42

sources.title: Odluka o komunalnom redu, Grad Mali Lošinj
sources.supports: article 42 drinking rule and exemptions (read directly)

local-law.note: Mali Lošinj only; Krk, Rab, Opatija and Rijeka not yet checked.

layers.process: Risnjak National Park charges an entry fee, valid for two days. The park's page lists adult tickets of EUR 8 and EUR 11 in two columns (1 January to 30 June and 1 September to 31 December, and 1 July to 31 August); students and pupils EUR 6 or 8; family ticket EUR 16 or 21; children under 7 free (about A$12.71 and A$17.48 for the adult prices at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293). Visitors keep the ticket during the stay and may move only within marked areas and on paths set for visiting.

zone-requirements.note: Risnjak: the page's column layout for the two price columns is ambiguous; confirm on the park ticket shop.
